# Annual Performance Plan and Report

The Government Performance and Results Modernization Act of 2010 (GPRA Modernization Act) requires each agency to report on work planned for the current and subsequent fiscal year. This plan provides the direct linkage between long-term strategic goals outlined in agencies' strategic plans and what managers and employees are expected to accomplish. The act also requires each agency to report on progress made in the previous fiscal year toward achieving the strategic goals and objectives in their Strategic Plan and Annual Performance Plan.
